column1: # MEASURED, with an important caveat. Computed from real per-step per-group rollout
# logs of the Qwen2.5-0.5B arithmetic GRPO validation run
# 12 runs x 40 steps = 480 step-rows, G in {2,4,8,16}, 3 seeds each).
# We report ONLY the RAW correlation: ZVF is strongly coupled to batch-mean reward
# (r=+0.74), as expected (more all-correct groups -> more zero-variance groups).
# We do NOT report a partial correlation "controlling for advantage variance":
# under binary outcome rewards the within-group advantage variance is a
# DETERMINISTIC transform of ZVF (zero iff the group is zero-variance), so
# partialling it out is circular (regressing ZVF on a function of itself).
# We also attach NO step-level p-value: the 480 rows are 12 runs x 40 AUTOCORRELATED
# those are withdrawn as circular/pseudoreplicated. Scope: small-scale ungated

column4: ZVF vs batch-mean reward (descriptive; step-rows autocorrelated, no valid p)
